meta.extraction: vector (PyMuPDF page.get_drawings(), OCG layers); text via get_text("words"); shell outline via rasterised vector lines (0.1 m) + contour; no tracing of rendered images
meta.worldFrame: metres; x = east, z = south (+z south, -z north), y = up; origin = centre of the site.pdf 22F tower rectangle (site page pt 1620.077, 762.686; 8.306 pt/m), same as src/scene/scale.ts pageToWorld()

scale.method: tower axis chain a-1..a-9 = 59000 mm (800/9100/11000/11000/11000/8600/6000/1500) found among grid-dimension/axis lines

transform.formula: x = px / pt_per_m + tx ; z = py / pt_per_m + tz  (px, py = PDF page pt, y down)
transform.fit: tower axis a-1 (x) and tower north axis (z) placed at the F13 world positions of the same axes (13F is registered to site.pdf); tower columns used as check (lower-floor columns are larger, so centres shift)

registration.note: rms/max = tower column centres on this sheet vs F13.json columns after the axis-based transform; lower-floor columns are bigger so a few cm of centre shift is expected

deskRule.rule: D046/D060: desk centre to column edge >= 1.10 m and desk bbox not intersecting columns
deskRule.note: desks kept exactly as drawn; violations are deviations, not moved

shell.method: raster 0.1 m, close 1.6 m, outside flood fill, roof cells removed (partition close 3.5 m), tower F13 outline OR-ed in on 4F+ = True, open 2.0 m (drops slivers < 2 m wide, also rounds fin zig-zag), cv2.findContours external, approxPolyDP 0.08 m

knownIssues: Shell outline = outer boundary of enclosure layers (walls, curtain walls/windows, doors, columns, filled core walls) rasterised at 0.1 m and closed with a 1.6 m disc; vertices snapped to the 0.1 m raster (approx. +-0.1 m), then simplified with 0.08 m tolerance. Railings, overlooks (OVLK) and slab lines are excluded, so open terraces are outside the shell.

Frame: tower axis a-1 and the tower north axis placed at their F13 world positions (13F registered to site.pdf); scale from the tower axis chain 59000 mm. Tower columns on this sheet are larger than on 13F, so their centres differ from F13 (see registration.columnResiduals).
Room polygons are axis-aligned ray-cast rectangles; curved (弧形) rooms and open halls are poorly represented; polygon=null for 105 of 171 labels.
2594 wall-layer segments at exactly 45/135 deg were treated as hatching and dropped.

Tower cores are copied from F13.json; podium/R&D cores are bounding boxes of clusters of lift symbols (BS-LIFT), stair geometry and filled core walls (1.0 m linkage); a core may include adjacent shafts/toilets drawn with filled walls.
elevation_m uses the scene formula (27.00); meta.levelFromDrawing holds the level read from this sheet (see README section 标高).
Desk-sized furniture rectangles without a chair at the desk were not counted as workstations: 1.0x1.9: 4.

Shell vs scene massing (integration d196dc0, cut at y=28.0 m): symmetric max deviation 11.05 m; plan 7457.3 m2 vs massing 7347.8 m2; plan outside massing 806.2 m2, massing outside plan 696.7 m2 (worst points in meta.shellVsMassing).

D075: the building outline for podium floors follows this per-floor plan (site.pdf only fixes the position through the tower frame); shellOutline is the authoritative podium outline. It is the outer ring only: atria, light wells and courtyards inside it are not cut out.

Shell post-processing: 2.0 m morphological opening (drops slivers < 2 m such as roof parapets / canopies glued on by the closing, and rounds the fin zig-zag); free-space cells containing roof notes (找坡屋面 / 坡顶标高 / 坡底标高 / 采光天井) and no room label are removed (meta.roofCellsRemoved).
19 desks are closer than 1.10 m to a column (min 0.497 m); not moved.

Shell vs scene massing (integration d196dc0, cut at y=28.0 m): symmetric max deviation 11.05 m; plan 7457.3 m2 vs massing 7347.8 m2; plan outside massing 806.2 m2, massing outside plan 696.7 m2 (worst points in meta.shellVsMassing).

shellVsMassing.method: symmetric boundary distance, both boundaries sampled every 0.25 m (shapely); plan shell = shellOutline (raw, includes fin zig-zag ~0.3-0.6 m)
shellVsMassing.sectionNote: scene massing cut at scene elevation of F07 + 1.0 m (scene formula 6+(n-2)*4.2)
